parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.description: The MAC address of an associated device. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.MACAddress}}.

parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: The time this group was collected. Formatted with the date-and-time string format as defined in {{bibref|RFC3339|Section 3}}.

parameters.name: HTCapabilities
parameters.description: Describes the HT capabilities of the Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: VHTCapabilities
parameters.description: Describes the VHT capabilities of the Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: HECapabilities
parameters.description: Describes the HE capabilities of the Associated Device (STA). {{deprecated|2.15|because it is superseded by {{object|WiFi6Capabilities}}}} {{obsoleted|2.17}} {{deleted|2.18}}

parameters.name: ClientCapabilities
parameters.description: The frame body of the most recently received (Re)Association Request frame from this client (STA), as defined in Table 9-34 and Table 9-36 of {{bibref|802.11-2020}} in the order of the underlying referenced standard.

parameters.name: LastDataDownlinkRate
parameters.description: The data transmit rate in {{units}} that was most recently used for transmission of data from the access point to the associated device. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.LastDataDownlinkRate}}.

parameters.name: LastDataUplinkRate
parameters.description: The data transmit rate in {{units}} that was most recently used for transmission of data from the associated device to the access point. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.LastDataUplinkRate}}.

parameters.name: UtilizationReceive
parameters.description: The amount of time in {{units}} that the Radio has spent on the Channel receiving data from this Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: UtilizationTransmit
parameters.description: The amount of time in {{units}} that the Radio has spent on the Channel transmitting data to this Associated Device (STA).

parameters.name: EstMACDataRateDownlink
parameters.description: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in {{units}} achievable in the downlink direction if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}.

parameters.name: EstMACDataRateUplink
parameters.description: Estimate of the MAC layer throughput in {{units}} achievable in the uplink direction if 100% of channel airtime and BSS operating bandwidth were available, as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}.

parameters.name: SignalStrength
parameters.description: An indicator of radio signal strength of the uplink from the associated STA to the access point - measured in {{units}}. RCPI is encoded per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-176}}, and described in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 10.3.1}}). Reserved: 221 - 255. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.SignalStrength}}.

parameters.name: LastConnectTime
parameters.description: The time in {{units}} since this Associated Device (STA) was associated.

parameters.name: BytesSent
parameters.description: The total number of bytes transmitted to the Associated Device. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.BytesSent}}.

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.description: The total number of bytes received from the Associated Device. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.BytesReceived}}.

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.description: The total number of packets transmitted to the Associated Device. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.PacketsSent}}.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.description: The total number of packets received from the Associated Device. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.PacketsReceived}}.

parameters.name: ErrorsSent
parameters.description: The total number of outbound packets that could not be transmitted because of errors. These might be due to the number of retransmissions exceeding the retry limit, or from other causes. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.ErrorsSent}}.

parameters.name: ErrorsReceived
parameters.description: The total number of inbound packets that contained errors preventing them from being delivered to a higher-layer protocol. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.ErrorsReceived}}.

parameters.name: RetransCount
parameters.description: The total number of transmitted packets which were retransmissions. Two retransmissions of the same packet results in this counter incrementing by two. If the instance of this {{object}} is the same as {{object|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}}}, then this parameter is the same as {{param|Device.WiFi.AccessPoint.{i}.AssociatedDevice.{i}.Stats.RetransCount}}.

parameters.name: MeasurementReport
parameters.description: {{list}} Measurement Report element(s) received from the Associated Device (STA) that constitute the latest Beacon report as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Figure 9-230}}.

parameters.name: NumberOfMeasureReports
parameters.description: The number of measurement report elements contained in {{param|MeasurementReport}}.

parameters.name: IPV4Address
parameters.description: IPV4 Address assigned to the client.

parameters.name: IPV6Address
parameters.description: IPV6Address assigned to the client.

parameters.name: Hostname
parameters.description: Hostname assigned to the client.

parameters.name: CellularDataPreference
parameters.description: This is the Cellular Data Preference for a Agile Multiband (AMB) capable STA This specifies the use of the cellular data connection. {{bibref|AMB}} {{enum}}

parameters.name: ReAssociationDelay
parameters.description: Re-association Delay {{bibref|AMB}}. The time, in {{units}}, after a BTM steer from AP1 to AP2 during which the station cannot go back and re-associate with AP1.

parameters.name: SleepMode
parameters.description: This parameter indicates the current operating sleep mode as recorded by the BSS {{bibref|802.11-2020}}. {{enum}}

parameters.name: SecurityAssociation
parameters.description: This parameter indicates the current operating security state as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 12.6.1.1}}. {{enum}}

parameters.name: PairwiseAKM
parameters.description: Pairwise AKM suite selector selected by the associated device (STA). The Pairwise AKM suite selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-151}}.

parameters.name: PairwiseCipher
parameters.description: Pairwise AKM cipher selector selected by the associated device (STA). The Pairwise AKM cipher selector (OUI and type) is encoded as a 4-octet hex-encoded value without internal delimiters, e.g. 506F9A02 {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-149, OUI field}}.

parameters.name: RSNCapabilities
parameters.description: The RSN Capabilities selected by the STA during association {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.24.4,}}.

parameters.name: TIDQueueSizesNumberOfEntries
parameters.description: {{numentries}}

object.description: Object describing a single Associated Device (STA).
